title: PWA telemetry envelope v1
description: The MQTT wire contract between the simulator (producer, slice S1) and the API ingest path (consumer, slice S2). Published to pwa/telemetry/{asset_id} at QoS 1. This file is the single source of truth for the wire format; both sides' test suites validate against it, so the format cannot drift silently.

message_id.description: Logical event identity: uuid5(NS, run_id|asset_id|tick). Stable within a run so a QoS-1 redelivery is idempotent; unique across runs because run_id is fresh per producer process. This is NOT the MQTT delivery identity (that is the broker's mid).

run_id.description: Identifies one producer process lifetime. Scopes the conservation invariant so concurrent or historical runs never contaminate a test assertion.

ts.description: Observation time, RFC3339 with an explicit UTC offset. Timezone-naive values are invalid and are dead-lettered by the consumer.

asset_id.description: Device identity. MUST exist in the seeded device roster; an unknown asset_id is the R1.5 dead-letter case and is injected deliberately by FaultMode.BAD_ASSET.

signal.description: Measured quantity. Mirrors the Signal literal in api/app/models.py; the two are pinned together by the consumer's contract test.

value.description: The measurement. MUST be finite - NaN and Infinity are not valid JSON numbers and are dead-lettered.
